model.note: Part outlines are traced from Massey Ferguson's MF 2800 M series product photo (cab and loader; exact model in the photo not stated) and are approximate. The engine, filters, fuel system, transmission, DPF and cooling are hidden and are in the parts list. The AGCO operator's manual and parts book were not available online: the manual link goes to MF's 2800 M page and the parts list is the brochure. Every interval here comes from club templates and every filter number is unverified: confirm with the AGCO dealer by serial AG3M28500PJT44943.

roof.name: Cab roof
roof.desc: Daily: tyres, lights, seat belt, ROPS/cab and loader hoses for rubbing or leaks.

cab.name: Cab, doors and glass
cab.desc: Cab air filter 6255554M2 (an AGCO-dealer listing title names the 2850M; AGCO parts book not seen). Front wiper blade: on some 2850s the blade and arm are one part; a US dealer quoted USD 36 for the blade and USD 81 for arm and blade. Check the DPF and regeneration lamps on the dash daily and do not interrupt a regen.

mirrorL.name: Mirror, left
mirrorL.desc: Cab mirror. Check in the daily walk-around.

mirrorR.name: Mirror, right
mirrorR.desc: Cab mirror. Check in the daily walk-around.

step.name: Cab step, left
step.desc: The fuel filter and water separator are on the right-hand side, ahead of the platform (opposite side to this step), with a water-in-fuel sensor and hand primer.

hood.name: Bonnet
hood.desc: Engine bay for the Iseki E4FH turbo diesel. Daily: engine oil, coolant and transmission/hydraulic levels; clean the radiator, oil cooler and grille screens; check the air filter restriction / service indicator.

fender.name: Rear fender, left
fender.desc: Check tyres, lights and for damage in the daily walk-around.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre, left
tyreFL.desc: Check tyres daily. Tyre size and pressures are not in the bible: read the sidewall and the operator's manual.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre, right
tyreFR.desc: Check tyres daily. Tyre size and pressures are not in the bible: read the sidewall and the operator's manual.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre, left
tyreRL.desc: Check tyres daily. Tyre size and pressures are not in the bible: read the sidewall and the operator's manual.

boom.name: Loader boom: MF FL 2811
boom.desc: MF FL 2811 loader (brochure). In heavy loader work grease the loader pivot pins daily (club practice); the 50 h template also lubricates the loader pivots. Check the loader hoses for rubbing or leaks daily.

tower.name: Loader mounting frame
tower.desc: Check the loader mounts and hoses for rubbing or leaks daily.

cylinder.name: Loader bucket cylinders and hoses
cylinder.desc: Check the cylinders and loader hoses for rubbing or leaks daily. Tractor implement flow is 47.8 L/min (brochure).

bucket.name: Bucket and Euro hitch
bucket.desc: The MF FL 2811 uses a Euro-hitch attachment system: grease the Euro-hitch pins daily in heavy loader work (club practice). The Notion list has a skid-steer quick-attach pin: check what is actually fitted.

engine.name: Engine: Iseki E4FH turbo diesel (Tier 4 Final)
engine.desc: 4-cylinder, 2.43 L, common rail, 36.4 kW (48.8 hp) at 2600 rpm, with DOC, EGR and DPF. Oil grade and capacity are not confirmed: a DPF engine needs the low-ash grade the AGCO manual specifies (Notion's 15W-40 CK-4, about 6.5 L, is unverified). Club templates (not checked against the AGCO manual): 250 h change the engine oil and filter, replace the fuel filter(s), clean the radiator fins and check the cooling system; 500 h adds valve clearance (dealer). About 289 h (Oct 2026) and inside the powertrain warranty (5 years in the US; AU terms not checked): make sure the first 50 h dealer service was done and keep services on record. Copy the service chart and fluid table from the operator's manual in the cab.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: No reliable number found. Notion's 1440250M1 could not be confirmed. Club template: change at 250 h.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Outer element 7068069M1 and inner (safety) element 7068070M1: aftermarket and AGCO-dealer listings name the 2850M; AGCO parts book not seen, confirm by serial. Notion's 4286128M1 / 4286129M1 do not match these listings. Check the restriction / service indicator daily.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, filter and water separator
fuel.desc: Diesel tank 53 L: low-sulphur diesel (DPF engine). Filter and water separator on the right-hand side ahead of the platform, with a water-in-fuel sensor and hand primer: drain water when the water-in-fuel light is on. Owner report (US forum): fuel gelling or water caused stalling under load; drain the separator and prime with the hand pump. Club template: replace at 250 h. Notion's 3900407M1 / 3900408M1 could not be confirmed.

hydraulics.name: Servo-HST transmission and hydraulics
hydraulics.desc: Servo-HST 3-range (HST only). Implement flow 47.8 L/min, steering 26.5 L/min, rear lift 1,580 kg (brochure). Fluid spec and capacity not confirmed (Notion: AGCO Permatran UTTO about 25 L, unverified). Check the level daily. Club template: replace the hydraulic/transmission oil and filter at 500 h; Notion's filter 3903202M1 could not be confirmed.

dpf.name: Exhaust after-treatment (DOC, EGR, DPF)
dpf.desc: The DPF needs regenerations: check the DPF / regeneration lamps daily, do not interrupt a regen, avoid lots of short idle runs and use the correct low-ash oil.

cooling.name: Radiator, oil cooler and coolant
cooling.desc: Coolant spec and capacity not confirmed. Clean the radiator, oil cooler and grille screens daily; check the coolant level daily. Club 250 h template: clean the radiator fins and check the cooling system.

driveline.name: Steering, brakes, PTO, linkage and drivelines
driveline.desc: Club 50 h template: inspect the air filter, belts, hoses, tyres, steering and brakes, and lubricate the steering components and loader pivots. Club 500 h template: inspect the PTO, linkage, steering, drivelines and hubs.
